---
title: "Arnéodo-Coullet-Tresser System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& ax-y\\
\dot{y} &=& -y+xz+x^3\\
\dot{z} &=& -bz+xy-z^2
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.58,b=0.2$ and initial condition $(-2,-1,0)$.
